ModMetaData.name: Drafted Command Priority
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Drafted Command Priority makes the player's drafted command chain authoritative until it has actually finished. Ordinary autonomous AI cannot take over while a player command is still active or queued. Optional Melee Pawn Auto Attack gives each drafted melee pawn a Fire-at-will-style toggle and a configurable 1-20 cell acquisition radius (default 4). Automatic melee is allowed to start only after player commands have finished and the pawn has returned to drafted idle / Wait_Combat; it never interrupts an already-running movement, rescue, hauling, attack, or other job. Downed, mental-state, and undrafted pawns are not locked. RimWorld 1.5.
